visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fixed-angle shot captures a large, modern digital billboard positioned at a street corner in Shinjuku. The billboard's screen is initially blank white, surrounded by the silhouettes of adjacent gray buildings under a bright, overcast sky. White and black text overlays are fixed at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The digital screen transitions to a bright turquoise background as three animated characters—one white, one light pink, and one light blue—burst through a stylized glass-shattering effect. The characters have round bodies, large expressive eyes, and small limbs, displaying joyful facial expressions. (3) The animated characters perform synchronized waving and bouncing motions on the screen, interacting within their 2D digital environment. The camera remains completely static, focusing on the billboard's display which occupies the center of the vertical frame against the urban background. (4) The animation on the billboard loops through its sequence of the characters appearing and dancing, while the environmental lighting remains consistent and flat. No human passers-by or vehicles are visible in the lower street-level portion of the frame.

visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up macro shot of a green, translucent plastic toy soldier in a salute pose. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the plastic texture. (2) Medium shot of a multi-colored, cube-shaped popcorn bucket featuring a green toy soldier on the top lid. The bucket is set against a brightly lit purple background. (3) Outdoor scene showing the bucket in front of a giant Woody head entrance at a theme park. The bucket has 'TOY STORY' branding and characters. (4) A person wearing a white t-shirt carries the bucket over their shoulder with a purple strap. The camera shows a side of the bucket designed like a notebook with 'Mission: Get Popcorn' text. (5) Close-up of the bucket's side featuring a circular maze game with a small Pixar ball inside. A hand is seen stabilizing the bucket. (6) Hand-held shot of another side of the bucket, which mimics a Pizza Planet crane machine game. A thumb slides a purple button to move an internal crane arm over a field of alien figures. (7) Top-down view into the bucket, showing it filled with buttered popcorn with the translucent lid partially open. (8) The person walks away from the camera, displaying the bucket hanging at hip level and a strap decorated with miniature toy soldier figures. (9) Final static shot of the front of the bucket, showcasing various Toy Story characters like Rex, Buzz Lightyear, and Slinky Dog around the logo.
